Name: Pillows 12 x 12 Inch
Short description:
Includes: 2 blank white pillowcases, cardstock, stuffing and instructions. Instructions: Stuff BLANK pillowcase and close zipper. Set aside. Place cardstock into PRINTED (or to be decorated) pillowcase to prevent markers from going through. Decorate printed pillowcases with markers. Insert stuffed pillow, zipper side first into decorated pillowcases and zip closed. Enjoy!

Personalize your pillows! Add your logo or photo to the pillowcase.

Minimum order of 15, plus a $15 setup fee.

Name: 4.5 oz. Libbey
Short description: Each CandleArt jar kit Includes colored granulated wax, 2 wicks (for use for havdala), spoon for layering wax, skewer for designing and wax to melt for sealing the candle. Similar to a sandart craft, using granulated wax instead of sand, to create your CandleArt in a jar. Instructions: Using a small spoon, slowly add wax to jar. When bottom layer is covered, insert wicks into center of jar. (They will become set in place as more wax is added.) Continue filling up the jar, leaving about 1/2 inch on the top. You could use a skewer to make designs.  Spoon melted wax over candle to set. Trim wicks to size. Enjoy!
